name: Ladykiller in a Bind
source:
Forced to pretend to be her twin brother on a cruise ship full of his classmates and enemies, the Beast finds herself thrown into a game of complex social, as well as literal bondage.

An erotic visual novel by the creators of Analogue: A Hate Story about social manipulation, crossdressing, and girls tying up other girls.

[From the press kit of the [url=http://ladykillerinabind.com/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
她被迫在一艘满载弟弟同学与仇敌的游轮上假扮自己的双胞胎弟弟，结果这个“野兽”被卷入了一场复杂的社交游戏，也被卷入了字面意义上的束缚之中。

这是一部由《Analogue：仇恨故事》创作者制作的色情视觉小说，主题包括社交操纵、异装，以及女孩把其他女孩绑起来。

[来源：官方[url=http://ladykillerinabind.com/]网站[/url]的宣传资料]
